changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[CalculatePassedPropertyForAssetResult] ( @ResultUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select AR.Uid, case when AR.PassCount=0 AND AR.FailCount=0 then 0 when (AR.PassCount / (AR.PassCount+AR.FailCount)) >= R.Threshold then 1 else 0 end as [Passed] from dbo.AssetResult AR, dbo.AssetResultEdge E, graph.AssetNode A, [Rule] R where AR.Uid = @ResultUid and MATCH(A-(E)->AR) and E.Class = 1 )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[CalculatePassedPropertyForAssetResult] ( @ResultUid uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select AR.Uid, case when AR.PassCount=0 AND AR.FailCount=0 then 0 when (AR.PassCount / AR.PassCount+AR.FailCount) >= R.Threshold then 1 else 0 end as [Passed] from dbo.AssetResult AR, dbo.AssetResultEdge E, graph.AssetNode A, [Rule] R where AR.Uid = @ResultUid and MATCH(A-(E)->AR) and E.Class = 1 )
